evals.prompt: compose me a dark 8 bar loop in aeolian, tension building into each cadence, tight voice leading. i'll play it in ableton as a loop
evals.expected_output: A rendered 8-bar loop: mode 5, loop wrap enabled, tension peaking on pre-cadence bars not arrivals, max melodic jumps small, seam distance low. Render archive + analysis saved.
assertions: Render is valid: notes on all 5 channels and no real hard violations (the beat-0 voice_budget artifact is allowed)
8 bars total: pl x render_length == 8 in the archived config
Aeolian honored: mode == 5 in the archived config
Loop wrap enabled: loop_wrap_weight > 0 in the archived config
Tension sits before the arrival: mean dissonant-pair share on pre-cadence bars (bar % pl == pl-2) exceeds that on arrival bars (bar % pl == pl-1)
Tight voice leading: no melodic jump exceeds 7 semitones in any voice
Loop seam is small: total last-to-first pitch distance summed over the 5 voices <= 15 semitones

evals.prompt: make a bright 16-bar piece where the voices have interlocking rhythms, and it should end with a strong final cadence
evals.expected_output: 16 bars, bright character (Lydian mode or bright matrix row), rhythm generators with voice rotation for interlock, strong tonic close on the last bar (root in bass, third present).
assertions: Render is valid: notes on all 5 channels and no real hard violations (the beat-0 voice_budget artifact is allowed)
16 bars total: pl x render_length == 16 in the archived config
Bright character: mode is major-family (0, 3 or 4) or the harmony_matrix_contour spends time on rows 3-5 (Ethereal/Bright)
Interlocking rhythm: rhythm_generators is non-empty with rhythm_voice_rotation >= 1, or voices demonstrably attack at offset times (not homorhythmic)
Strong final close: the last bar's downbeat chord has the bass on the chord root and a third present
